tools.name: director_media
tools.summary: List shared image/video metadata, inspect entity mesh/material surface indexes, or import local media by desktop path (revision+requestId; optional entityId attaches it). No audio. For surface mapping, visual/particle/field/deformation/warp guidance read director_skill({path:"references/media.md"}) only when needed; director_help(names:["director_media"]) retains the exact contract.

tools.name: director_skill
tools.summary: Read enabled skills on demand. No arguments reads the built-in director skill. path alone reads a built-in text reference, e.g. references/camera.md, references/prompt-writing.md, references/media.md or references/editing.md. action:list lists user-enabled skills; id reads one skill, optional path reads its bundled text reference. Read only relevant instructions. Pass knownVersion only when that version is already in this conversation; unchanged:true skips the main instructions. Disabled skills no longer guide new tasks, even if their text remains in history. Installation and toggles belong to the user in AI > Skills. No writes or script execution.

tools.name: director_scene
tools.summary: Default to editing the CURRENT scene with director_apply. Only create/copy/continue when the user asks for a separate scene, alternative or continuation; rooms along a continuous shot stay in one scene. Manage independent scenes, separate from camera cuts. list/read are queries. Mutations use revision + requestId. create(name,template?,newSceneId?) and copy(sceneId?,name) select the new scene; switch(sceneId) changes active scene. continue(name) creates a scene from ACTIVE scene last output frame, preserving original scene. Read director_continuity for predecessor history. rename/reorder/remove also supported; query help for details.

tools.name: director_continuity
tools.summary: Read saved predecessor story and actual last-frame positions/poses, paged by offset/limit; follow nextOffset when all objects are needed. Source may since have changed; this is a frozen snapshot. director_spatial reads the current live scene instead.

tools.name: director_nodes
tools.summary: Inspect source/instance node hierarchy and real node bounds for an imported entityId. Optional time/path/query/offset/limit. Advanced: use only when editing model internals.

tools.name: director_path_surface
tools.summary: Check a moving entityId route against surfaces; optional surfaceId/clearance/tolerance. Use after stairs/platform changes when route height matters. Does not edit or automatically find a route.

tools.name: director_stride
tools.summary: Advanced read-only humanoid stride estimate for entityId + retarget clipId. Requires supported loaded skeleton; query help before applying locomotion calibration. Not needed for ordinary blocking.

tools.name: director_read
tools.summary: Read on demand. Always returns revision, scene identity, duration/fps/aspect and creationMode. geometry palette is returned only in geometry mode. Default: entity summaries with color/reference; ids + details:true reads selected full objects/ports. sections:[entities|scene|cuts|production|references|resources|statistics|selection] selects data; []=core only, [all]=everything. scene includes room/lighting/floors/zones/editorView; selection is returned only when requested and gives UI-selected objects, clips and timeRange for scoped edits. production is COMPLETE notes+fixedPrompt+promptText; read it before replacing notes if unknown. Omitted sections are NOT empty. details alone never gathers global statistics. resourceId inspects that model. No image/model bytes. Reuse known data and automatic task snapshots.

tools.name: director_assets
tools.summary: Search only the needed built-in models by query, queries:[names], exact ids or type filters. Empty input returns no catalog. Default 8 matches; found:false and missingQueries/missingIds mean no match. Do not scan all pages before building. Geometry mode uses known IDs from director_read.geometry directly when width/height/depth suffice. For unknown angle/thickness/segments or other parameters, use director_assets({ids:[neededId],details:true}); do not search humanoid, furniture or motion libraries. Request details only for unknown parameters.

tools.name: director_motions
tools.summary: Find humanoid motions by query. source=user searches the local user library (paged); omitted/builtin searches built-ins. Use returned id in {operation:"motion",id:actorId,asset:presetId,time:0,duration:sceneSeconds}; omitted duration uses source default. User motions require complete mapping; sources embed in project. Humans/crowds only.

tools.name: director_apply
tools.summary: Edit the current scene in place; no new project or scene is needed. Commit 1-100 operations atomically with current revision and unique requestId; undoable. Normal edits commit directly. Invalid input rolls back the batch. add:{asset,id?,name?,position?,patch?}; omit kind for built-ins/camera, kind is only for imported resources. update:{id,patch}; remove:{id}; project:{patch:{duration,fps,aspect,name,room,zones,creationMode,referenceLabels}}; cuts:{value:[{time:0,cameraId}]} (replaces timeline). motion:{id,asset:presetId,time:0,duration:seconds}. Same-batch add IDs may be used by following motions/cuts. project.referenceLabels toggles actor/crowd/capsule name labels in camera preview and exported reference video (default false). Entity patch supports color:"#RRGGBB", position/rotation/scale, path:{smooth:false,points:[{time,position:[x,y,z]}]}, clips:[{id,action,start,end,speed:1}]. Geometry values use the catalog parameterPatchField. camera shallow-merges e.g. {focal:50,target:[0,1.2,0]}; arrays and other nested objects replace wholly, read existing data before replacing. notes uses value:{fixedPrompt:"",sceneReferenceIds:[],notes:[{id,start,end,actorId:"",story:"",emotion:"",dialogue:"",action:""}]}; actorId empty or existing actor. Optional production.promptText stores the complete scene video-generation prompt; read director_skill({path:"references/prompt-writing.md"}) when composing it. Preserve existing promptText when editing notes; use full production value, not patch. If unknown, read sections:[production] first; omitted data is not empty. Unknown formats may use preview:true; preview creates no objects. Commit returned previewId with unchanged revision + NEW requestId, omitting operations. A stale preview needs revalidation. Keep locked entities and concurrent user changes. camera-motion and lighting-preset operations generate editable cinematography/environment presets; camera.effects adds animated lens/framing/shake/distortion, project.lighting and light-* assets add lighting. For camera/lighting guidance read director_skill({path:"references/camera.md"}) only when needed. For continuous movement, path or camera.targetPath may use {smooth:false,interpolation:"continuous",points:[{time,position,stop?}]}; velocity/acceleration stay continuous, middle points pass, endpoints stop unless stop:false, repeated positions hold, easing must be omitted/linear. Omit interpolation to retain old behavior; smooth alone does not smooth path speed. camera.targetPath controls independent world look-at points; camera.aimResponse:{duration:0..2} optionally eases target tracking (0/omitted=exact; free+manual/POV bypass). Choose timings/stops as needed; do not automatically alter old paths. For imported rig/clips, handBinding, contactAnchors, floors, zones, structureLink, resource edits and replace-prop, read director_skill({path:"references/editing.md"}) only when needed. director_help(names:["director_apply"]) retains the exact parameter contract.

tools.name: director_spatial
tools.summary: Sample actual positions, bounds and camera framing at time. Optional ids returns only those entities (including crowd members); all scene objects still participate in occlusion. objects.zoneIds identifies named regions containing each current origin; zones are returned with bounds/connections. cameraId:"program" follows cuts; otherwise use an existing camera ID. occlusionKeys:["entity:ID"] requests ray samples. AABB overlap is approximate; sampled visibility never proves whole-scene correctness.

tools.name: director_scan
tools.summary: Optional interval inspection: start/end/sampleFps and targetKey:"entity:ID" or "all-people", optional cameraId and occlusion. Returns jobId. Approximate samples; not required for every draft. director_job checks progress.

tools.name: director_view
tools.summary: Set preview time, optional cameraId (program or existing ID) and selected entityId. Does not change the project or cut timeline.

tools.name: director_history
tools.summary: Undo/redo one batch with current revision and action:"undo"|"redo". Respects normal editor history.

tools.name: director_export
tools.summary: Export kind:project|screenshot|video|bundle to local save flow. Video uses program cuts and project fps, optional start/end/size (640,1280,1920 long edge). Returns jobId for long work. save-requested means dialog requested, not disk save confirmed. No arbitrary filesystem paths.

tools.name: director_job
tools.summary: Read job status/result by id; optional cancel:true. Do not repeatedly poll a running job without waiting.

tools.name: director_help
tools.summary: Read full contracts for 1-3 named tools when advanced parameters are needed. Common scene construction uses the short descriptions directly; do not fetch all help before starting.
